main_concerns.concern: The completion claim rests on internal receipts (redcap check, formal-usable check, complete-revival check) and references to external E2E files that were not supplied for review, reproducing the historical 'framework-as-completion' failure mode the E2E contract explicitly warns against.

The main claim lists 8 required capabilities (Loom, self-purification, Cap persona, Forge/arsenal, project install, Hook, repeated E2E, terminal-goal) but the 13 evidence items only substantiate 6. Forge/arsenal and project install have no dedicated evidence. Furthermore, all evidence is uncommitted (untracked or unstaged modifications), meaning the work is still in progress — a completion claim on uncommitted evidence is premature by definition.

minimum_fixes.minimum_fix: Do not close the active goal yet. Re-bundle the three external-project E2E artifacts (plus the Codex Hook log and Prism merge/resolution files) within the bounded-read limits and re-run Prism review. Claim completion only after an independent Prism pass confirms the external E2E reality, not merely internal receipts.

Before closing the active goal: (1) Provide or reference existing evidence that Forge/arsenal and project install are implemented and verified — or remove them from the completion claim. (2) Commit all evidence to the repository so the completion baseline is stable and reviewable. (3) Ensure the Prism binary modification is reviewed by an independent mechanism (e.g., a pre-modification Prism binary, or manual human review). (4) Move E2E evidence from /private/tmp/ into the repository evidence directory. (5) Run one final check pass against the committed state.
